summary: Send only the ID and name of each selected Catalog choice in mobile AI batch requests.
noAssistantImpact: This fixes the mobile payload for the existing form-only batch procedure.

docs.note: The existing strict input contract already requires an ID and name for each choice.

evidence.result: The strict contract rejects full Catalog variant objects and accepts the mapped choice payload. A rolled-back Development transaction reserved both existing Broiler choices.
